description: Book a Renzy plumber to visit the customer's address in one arrival window. Call check_availability first and use a slot_id it returned. Confirm the window, the hourly rate and the address with the customer before calling this. It sends the customer's name, phone number, address and a description of the problem to Renzy, who will phone to confirm the visit. It does not collect or charge a card. Each call creates a new booking, so do not retry a call that succeeded.
name: book_plumber
title: Book a plumber
